messages:
incident-bot: [P1] ALERT: sudden spike in KV prefix cache occupancy and continuous-batcher queue depth in us-west-2 across multiple hosts. Detection rule: cache.evictions > 500/min AND batcher.queue_ms > 200ms. Paging eng-oncall.

Alice Martinez: Got the page. Seeing >8x baseline evictions and 350ms avg batch queue. Latency SLOs are starting to breach for tail requests.

Ben Choi: Cheers — I'll join. Any customer-facing errors?

Ravi Patel: Support shows increased error rates for embeddings endpoint for 3 tenants (acme-inc, bright-labs, nightwatch). Errors are 503s and timeouts from our gateway.

Sasha Ivanov: Pulling runtime metrics. Looks like continuous-batcher changed behavior after yesterday's batch-config roll. Effective batch_min_tokens increased inadvertently to 64 for some shards -> large KV cache churn + KV paging.

Maya Lin: Notified CSMs for the three tenants. They're seeing degraded throughput and some requests time out after 12s.

Liam O'Connor: I'm seeing hot eviction storms causing disk pressure on cache-backend for a subset of pod replicas. Could cascade. Suggest limiting batcher concurrency ASAP.

Ben Choi: Agreed. We'll do a targeted flag flip per-tenant and then do a canary revert of the batch-config globally if needed. Who can flip flags?

Alice Martinez: I can flip the feature flag and apply per-tenant overrides. Plan: 1) Canary revert for one safe tenant (dev-sandbox), 2) Per-customer override for acme-inc and bright-labs, 3) Monitor 10m, 4) Roll forward gradually.

Sasha Ivanov: Command to set per-tenant override (internal tool):
```
redwood flags set batcher.min_tokens --tenant=acme-inc --value=16 --reason="mitigation - reducing min_tokens to limit KV churn"
```
Will that work?

Alice Martinez: Running it now against acme-inc.

deploy-bot: flag-update: batcher.min_tokens for tenant=acme-inc set to 16 by Alice M (change-id: f2d4b1).

Alice Martinez: Flip applied. Observability: evictions for acme-inc dropped 70% within 30s. Latency p95 improved ~120ms.

Ravi Patel: Acme CSM confirms throughput recovered. Nightwatch still degraded.

Maya Lin: Contacted nightwatch team; they're OK with a rapid fix but want rollover windows.

Alice Martinez: Applying same override to bright-labs and nightwatch.

deploy-bot: flag-update: batcher.min_tokens for tenant=bright-labs set to 16 by Alice M (change-id: f2d4b2).

deploy-bot: flag-update: batcher.min_tokens for tenant=nightwatch set to 16 by Alice M (change-id: f2d4b3).

Sasha Ivanov: Good improvements across those tenants. Global cache eviction rate down ~60%. Queue depth returning to normal.

Liam O'Connor: Still seeing some pressure on cache-backed disks on older replicas. I'm draining pods with high eviction counters and restarting them to reclaim memory.

Ben Choi: Next step: revert the unintended global batch-config change that pushed min_tokens to 64. Can we do a controlled canary rollback?

Sasha Ivanov: Yes. We prepare a staged rollout to 5% of traffic first (dev-sandbox -> non-prod -> 5% prod). Script:
```
# rollback global config to previous value 16 with staged rollout
redwood configs apply batcher.min_tokens=16 --rollout=staged --stages=dev-sandbox,non-prod,prod:5% --reason="rollback hotfix to mitigate eviction spike"
```
I'll kick it off after we confirm canary metrics.

Alice Martinez: Canary on dev-sandbox passed — no regressions. Initiating non-prod stage.

deploy-bot: config-rollout: batcher.min_tokens -> 16 stage=non-prod initiated by Sasha I (rollout-id: r-88a1).

Sasha Ivanov: Non-prod stable for 7m. P95 batch queue reduced, evictions low. Kicking 5% prod stage now.

deploy-bot: config-rollout: stage=prod:5% started (rollout-id: r-88a1).

Ravi Patel: Monitoring customer-facing errors. ACME, Bright-labs, Nightwatch all showing stable behavior. No new 5xx.

Maya Lin: CSMs updated. Customers appreciative of quick response.

Ben Choi: Increase rollout to 20%? We should be cautious — check KV eviction trend and disk IO for 10m after 5% stage completes.

Sasha Ivanov: After 10m at 5% the trend looks good. Increasing to 20%.

deploy-bot: config-rollout: increased to prod:20% (rollout-id: r-88a1).

Liam O'Connor: Disk IO now trending down cluster-wide. Drained 3 affected replicas, rebalanced cache under-replicated partitions.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (per-tenant overrides + staged rollback). Severity downgraded from P1 -> P2. Keep monitoring for 1h.

Alice Martinez: I'll keep the per-tenant overrides in place for 24h as a safety net and schedule a follow-up postmortem. Action items: 1) Root cause: investigate why batch-config rollout defaulted to 64 for a subset of shards, 2) Add guardrail to prevent min_tokens > 32 in canary without explicit approval, 3) Postmortem and customer impact report.

Ben Choi: Agreed. Assigning RCA to Sasha + Liam. I'll own communication and the postmortem draft.

Sasha Ivanov: Noted. Collecting logs and rollout metadata (change-ids f2d4b1/f2d4b2/f2d4b3 and rollout r-88a1).

Ravi Patel: I'll compile list of affected requests and customer impact windows for the report.

Maya Lin: CSMs will prepare customer communication drafts; let me know when postmortem ready for review.

Alice Martinez: Closing the live mitigation loop — we'll reconvene in 1h to confirm stable. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
